summary: Iteration 3 tests three new features (multi-sheet layouts, request-form attachments, SSE streaming) end-to-end. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests passing (12 new + 25 regression). Attachment upload (.txt + PNG) + byte-identical roundtrip through Emergent Object Storage verified. Unsupported extensions (.exe, no-extension) rejected 400. Cross-client 403 enforced. Download requires auth (401 without token). SSE endpoint requires auth (401). Multi-sheet PDF export with 2 diagram_pngs -> valid PDF with >=2 embedded Image XObjects. Legacy plan.layout (single-sheet) job returns valid data. LLM generation NOT re-triggered (main agent already verified 3 stages + 3753 deltas). Frontend: Client login -> open Marine Dr job (b7a59a50) -> site_memo.txt chip visible + click downloads 172 bytes -> Layout Diagram tab -> sheet-tab-0 + sheet-tab-1 present, switching re-renders SVG -> hidden #layout-svg-export-0/-1 both in DOM -> Export PDF (335KB, %PDF- header, 3 embedded images >=2). Regression on Watermain repair (legacy plan.layout) -> layout tab still renders schematic diagram, no sheet-tabs (single sheet). New Request form with .txt attachment: form-attachments-input works, names show, submit -> new job with attachment chip + no-plan-state (did not generate).

minor.issue: Response only returns id/filename/content_type/size — text_excerpt (used later for LLM grounding) not surfaced to client, so caller cannot preview it. Minor UX.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:82 ExportIn keeps deprecated diagram_png (singular) alongside diagram_pngs — good for backward compat, but frontend already fully migrated to diagram_pngs; consider removing singular in a future cleanup.

server.py:210 stream_generate error handler restores prev_status via 'prev_status if prev_status != generating else draft' — good; but if the initial DB fetch returned status='generating' from a prior crashed request, this would silently keep it as draft rather than reflect the real prior state. Non-critical.

Dashboard.js:76 stream 'text' rolling buffer truncated with .slice(-700) — fine for UX preview, but the chars counter continues incrementing based on delta.text.length so no data loss for UI counter. Good.

Dashboard.js:57 Bearer token read from localStorage.getItem('tmait_token'). If the axios interceptor stores a different key (e.g. via cookie fallback), a token-refresh scenario could break the SSE call. Verified token key is consistent throughout in this codebase — good, but fragile.
atom.py:113 attachment text_excerpt is trimmed to 2500 chars per attachment; if a client uploads many large PDFs the prompt could get long. Consider a total budget cap. Non-blocking.
storage.py:6 _storage_key is module-global singleton — fine for single-worker uvicorn but under gunicorn with multiple workers each worker will re-init. Acceptable.
RequestForm.js:36 sequential await api.post per file — for many attachments this serializes uploads; Promise.all would be faster. Minor perf.

ActionsPanel.js:34 exportPdf loops i<12 checking each layout-svg-export-i — hard-coded 12-sheet ceiling matches TMM max staging; a plan with more sheets would silently drop the rest. Non-issue in practice.
